protocol: Three independent baseline/candidate pairs per scenario with alternating execution order, a fresh benchmark process per run and one discarded warm-up sample per process. Speedup is median baseline duration divided by median candidate duration; median_paired_speedup is the median of the three per-pair ratios. Seeds and model initialization are fixed, every sample records a workload work hash, and CUDA is synchronized at measurement boundaries. Benchmark workloads only: not complete training runs and not trained-model strength evaluations.

harness.revision_note: The collection used this harness with larger GPU budgets than its small CPU defaults (recorded per run in configuration).
